items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Omar Simeone, he went with Earl Hines

ctx.x: I see. That's how you got up with Jell-A. Yeah, that's how I got up with Jell-A-Roll-Martin. Because King Oliver's band broke up.

See, Bonnie Biggore went with Duke Oliver and Omar Simeone, he went with Earl Hines and I, Paul Barnes, went with Jell-A-Roll-Martin. But times were tough. I bet it was. When I got to New York it was just a little before Littborg flew across the ocean. Oh yeah? Oh.

items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: Now Simeon left and he went to Milwaukee and then back he joined Earl Hines band.

ctx.x: That's when Barney went with him.

And yeah, Barney Big Odd went with him. And Duke Ellington was looking for me for saxophone, but he couldn't find me. So instead of getting me he got Johnny Hodges. Now Simeon left and he went to Milwaukee and then back he joined Earl Hines band. So Louis Russ, I was around doing anything. I was playing around with different bands, a fellow called Wilkins, a piano player, and Edgar Dow, a piano player, Jinger Young, Richard Cheatham from Cleveland, Ohio. I played a gig with Chick Webb's band. You know, a…
I believe I heard it, Dave Nelson.
